usual_baseline: Handover and ward round notes miss key items. RCS minimum dataset met in 31–45% [2462][2629][2764]. Outstanding tasks 6.2–38% [2070][1516]. Escalation plan 0%, drug monitoring 1% [2153]. Ward round VTE 0–26.5%, ceiling of care 1%, fluid balance 16% [2128][2761]. Trauma meetings documented in 64% [1692].
fix_that_works: Structured templates, especially electronic. Weekend handover sticker: escalation plan 0% to 87%, diagnosis 21% to 96% [2153]. Ward round template: essential criteria 32% to 93%, VTE 70% to 98% [2502]. Handover list: outstanding tasks 6.2% to 80% [2070]. Electronic proforma: all but one criterion ≥95% [1516]. Trauma presentation template: complete 24.0% to 81.3% [1749].
fix_that_fails: Items without a template field stay poor: blood results 19% to 20% [1439], resuscitation status 7.0% to 9.2% [2354], whom to contact 0% to 14.70% [1620], TTO 12% to 5% [1544]. Teaching alone left diagnosis, VTE and antimicrobials unchanged [2653]. Induction tutorial plateaued at 50% completeness [2808]. Fluid balance worsened after a template [2501].
consultant_advice: Very heavily overdone; forty audits, same result. Don't start another unless your unit has no template. Audit whether the template is still used after changeover, or target the items templates miss, such as resuscitation status, pending results and weekend handover.
